edits.softPalateSourceRest: registered INIT + local clearance against tongue

localTongueFit.method: smooth positive-Z medial patch from F actual crown contacts

lipContextFit.method: positive affine registration blended continuously through actual open-mouth tissue
lipContextFit.sourcePart: active FEM boundary; duplicated filled lip meshes discarded

contactSurfaceRefinement.method: conforming red/green triangle edge refinement of source contact patches
contactSurfaceRefinement.surfacePositionChange: existing points unchanged; generated points are original edge midpoints

nasalLining.sourceStatus: AUTHORED UNMEASURED reconstruction from oral/face frame; no acquired nasal donor surface
nasalLining.palatalFloorLayer: outer floor is source-conforming 0.8mm above actual oral roof wherever its vertical triangle intersection exists; variable authored separator thickness, no acquired bone claim

anteriorFloorExtension.meaning: anterior extension/vestibule beyond acquired palatal coverage remains authored; not a measured palate connection

posteriorSourceWall.method: +X ray into actual source pharyngeal surface

formulas.floor: quadratic Bezier from actual midline palatal roof quantiles + authored 2.5–4mm separator; anterior floor at least rear-6.5mm
formulas.airHeight_m: reference H=.028*(1-.20*smoothstep(u))+.002*sin(pi*u)^2; posterior choana flares from .60*H to H during first25% of body; center follows reference H
formulas.posterior: superior pharyngeal open port, AP half-height4.8mm; posterior and side tissue only through the bend, anterior/floor C-window leaves existing SOFT_PALATE as the moving wall; fixed full floor starts anterior to the bend over hard palate; source apposition measured below
formulas.vestibule: cubic Bezier tangent transition, open air port behind anterior source face bound
formulas.conchae: closed curved scroll ribbons, bilateral, tapered to12% at longitudinal ends; local thickness caps, no centroid fan across C-shaped meatus

NASAL_LINING.movingAnteriorBoundary: existing acquired SOFT_PALATE, not the authored lining

NASAL_CONCHA_INFERIOR.source: authored tapered scroll, not acquired turbinates

NASAL_CONCHA_MIDDLE.source: authored tapered scroll, not acquired turbinates

NASAL_CONCHA_SUPERIOR.source: authored tapered scroll, not acquired turbinates

limits: Roof, vestibule, conchae and wall thickness are authored assumptions, not measurements. Tapered concha tips are very thin; retain float32 positions or validate any quantized export against minimumFullThickness_m.
Septum omitted for the teaching cutaway; no claim of complete bilateral nasal anatomy.
Posterior source apposition is reported quantitatively, not assumed a measured registration. The open-anterior transition deliberately leaves the acquired velum as its moving anterior wall.
Concha root intentionally embeds .1mm in lining for tissue attachment; this is not an independent donor fit.
Finite topology/section checks do not replace global intersections, final GLB checks or qualified anatomical review.

softPalateBoundaryTrim.operation: difference of authored lining and outward-offset acquired velum; moving tissue remains the cavity boundary
